entities.name: Geneviève de Fontenay
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Geneviève Suzanne Marie-Thérèse Mulmann, known professionally as Geneviève de Fontenay, was a French businesswoman who served as the president of the Miss France Committee from 1981 until 2007. After leaving her position with Miss France, Fontenay created the beauty pageant Miss Prestige National in 2010, and served as its president until her retirement in 2016.

entities.summary: Geneviève Suzanne Marie-Thérèse Mulmann, known professionally as Geneviève de Fontenay, was a French businesswoman who served as the president of the Miss France Committee from 1981 until 2007. After leaving her position with Miss France, Fontenay created the beauty pageant Miss Prestige National in 2010, and served as its president until her retirement in 2016.
